evals.prompt: Create a plan for adding a WebSocket notification endpoint to the API. It will touch src/server.ts, src/ws-handler.ts, and tests/ws.test.ts.
evals.description: Happy path: new plan touching 3+ files triggers risk file creation. Verifies plan.mem, slice.mem, progress, and risk.mem are all written.
evals.expected_output: plan.mem contains ≥3 numbered steps with text and deps fields. slice.mem contains the ready frontier (steps with no unmet deps). progress updated to 0/N. risk.mem written because 3+ files are touched.

assertions.text: .memplan/slice.mem exists and contains at least one step entry
.memplan/risk.mem exists because the task touches 3+ files
At least one +step: entry in plan.mem has a deps= field indicating ordering was inferred

evals.prompt: Plan: add a comment to README.md.
evals.description: Small single-file task: only 1 file touched, no irreversible ops. Verifies risk.mem is NOT written.
evals.expected_output: plan.mem written with 1-2 steps. risk.mem is NOT written because only 1 file is touched.

assertions.text: .memplan/plan.mem exists and contains at least one step
.memplan/risk.mem does not exist after the skill runs

evals.prompt: Plan a database migration: drop the legacy_users table and rebuild it with a new schema. This is irreversible.
evals.description: Irreversible operation triggers risk.mem even with only 1 file. Verifies the irreversible check fires correctly.
evals.expected_output: plan.mem written. risk.mem written because the task contains an irreversible operation (drop table).

assertions.text: .memplan/plan.mem exists with steps covering the migration
.memplan/risk.mem exists and its irreversible field is not 'none'
